name: Gaussian Splatting for Microscopy
definition: Decomposes an nD microscopy volume V into a mixture of K anisotropic Gaussians to represent nD images, enabling interactive web visualization and compression.
summary: Gaussian Splatting for Microscopy decomposes n-dimensional fluorescence volumes into oriented Gaussian primitives for interactive web visualization, initializing splats directly from voxel data to avoid intermediate grids.
